endcard: Save this for the restless nights

save.ar:
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ
أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
save.tr: “Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured.”

lines.say: Restless, even when nothing is wrong? Allah tells you where a heart finds rest.
lines.cap: Restless, even when nothing is wrong?

lines.say: Allah says: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
lines.cap: “By the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured”

lines.say: Ibn Kathir explains: their hearts find comfort with Allah, and become tranquil when He is remembered.
lines.cap: Their hearts find comfort with Allah and become tranquil when He is remembered

lines.say: They are pleased to have Him as their Protector and Supporter.
lines.cap: Pleased to have Him as their Protector and Supporter

lines.say: And the Prophet said: the one who remembers his Lord, compared to the one who does not, is like the living compared to the dead.
lines.cap: Like the living compared to the dead

lines.say: So when your heart won't settle, turn back to Him: in your prayer, in your dua, in a quiet SubhanAllah.
lines.cap: When your heart won't settle, turn back to Him: prayer, dua, a quiet SubhanAllah

lines.say: Save this for the restless nights, and share it with someone who needs rest.
lines.cap: Save this for the restless nights & share it 🤍

v1.ar:
ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ
أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
v1.tr: “Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allāh. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allāh hearts are assured.”

h1.ar:
مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ
مَثَلُ الْحَىِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ
h1.tr: “The example of the one who celebrates the Praises of his Lord (Allah) in comparison to the one who does not celebrate the Praises of his Lord, is that of a living creature compared to a dead one.”
